kebab_example: aliyun outboundbot describe-tts-demo --instance-id a8eccb3c-2b26-4b6d-a54f-696b953e33a6 --text '测试' --api-version 2019-12-26 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTTSDemo

parameters.help_en:
The voice information, such as aixia, siyue, or xiaoyun. For the complete list of voices, refer to the voice list below.
Because the voice ID for a cloned voice is a dynamic value generated during voice cloning, a specific voice ID cannot be provided at this stage. To obtain the specific voice ID, you must call the ListVoiceClone operation on the cloned voice page
parameters.help_zh:
发音人信息，如：aixia / siyue / xiaoyun，完整发音人信息参考下方音色列表。

由于克隆音色的Voice是不同非固定的值，在声音复刻时生成，导致现阶段无法提供具体的Voice（具体的VoiceID需要在克隆音色页面中获取请求ListVoiceClone信息）
parameters.name: voice

parameters.help_en: The speech rate. Valid values: an integer from -500 to 500. Default value: 0. A value greater than 0 increases the pitch. A value less than 0 decreases the pitch
parameters.help_zh:
语速
[-500,500]之间整数。默认值为0。

大于0表示加快语速。

小于0表示减慢语速
parameters.name: speech_rate

parameters.help_en: The volume. Valid values: an integer from 0 to 100. Default value: 50. A value greater than 50 increases the volume. A value less than 50 decreases the volume
parameters.help_zh:
音量
[0,100]之间整数。默认值为50。

大于50表示增大音量。

小于50表示减小音量
parameters.name: volume

parameters.help_zh:
语调
[-500,500]之间整数。默认值为0。

大于0表示升高音高。

小于0表示降低音高
parameters.name: pitch_rate

parameters.help_en:
The speech service type. 

When ali is used as the custom service, this field stores the AppKey of the interactive voice response project.

When xunfei is used as the custom service provider, this field stores the corresponding AppKey
parameters.help_zh:
语音服务类型 

当使用ali当作自定义服务时，此字段用来保存智能语音交互产品项目的appKey。

当使用xunfei作为自定义服务方时，保存对应的appKey
parameters.name: app_key

parameters.help_en:
The AccessKey secret of the namespace.

When the engine is xunfei, you must enter the AccessKey secret
parameters.help_zh:
该命名空间的AccessKey Secret（SK）。

当engine为xunfei时，需要将其SK填入
parameters.name: secret_key

parameters.help_en:
The AccessKey ID of the namespace.
When the engine is xunfei, you must enter the AccessKey ID
parameters.help_zh:
该命名空间的AccessKey（AK）。
当engine为xunfei时，需要将其AK填入
parameters.name: access_key

parameters.help_en:
The storage engine. Valid values: ali, volc, and xunfei.

Set the value to ali when you use traditional voices, CosyVoice, or Alibaba Cloud as the custom service.
Set the value to volc when you use the Doubao service.
Set the value to xunfei when you use iFLYTEK as the service provider. This value can only be used in small model scenarios.
Set the value to dock and set NlsServiceType to Authorized when you use a self-managed service.
Set the value to bailian when you use CV-v3-flash and Qwen voices
parameters.help_zh:
存储引擎。可选择【ali、volc、xunfei】

使用传统音色、CosyVoice、自定义服务选择阿里时，填入ali。
使用doubao服务时，须填入volc。
使用xunfei作为服务方时，填入 xunfei （只能在小模型场景使用）
使用自有服务时，需要填写dock，同时NlsServiceType需要填写Authorized。
使用CV-v3-flash与千问音色时，需填写bailian
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en:
The service type. Valid values:
Managed: the default service for the outbound robot product, which is a public service.
Authorized: the interactive voice response service purchased by public cloud customers, which is a custom service. You can configure it by choosing system administration > third-party speech configuration.

When you need to use Alibaba Cloud interactive voice response, which means using Alibaba Cloud as the custom service provider, set the value to Authorized
parameters.help_zh:
服务类型
Managed：智能外呼产品默认服务（公共服务）。
Authorized：公有云客户自己购买的智能语音交互产品服务（自定义服务），通过系统管理-第三方语音配置。

当需要使用阿里智能语音交互时，即使用阿里作为自定义服务方时须要填入Authorized
parameters.name: nls_service_type

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud custom voice, which is the voice call ID
parameters.help_zh: 阿里定制语音，即为声音调用ID
parameters.name: ali_customized_voice

parameters.help_en: The extended parameters. When Engine is set to dock, you must specify the configuration ID
parameters.help_zh: 扩展参数，当Engine使用dock时，需要填写其配置ID
parameters.name: ext_params

AuditionUrl.description_en: The URL of the preview file

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
